manifest.dataset_name: FANUC × AIonOS Exhibition Dashboard Synthetic Dataset
source_domains_covered: OPC UA DI/DO/Registers/Position Registers/selected process values
Optional RSI / High Speed Position Output simulation
limitations: Native FANUC OPC UA NodeIds are not available in the supplied document.
Exact native ZDT JSON response bodies are not available in the supplied document.
Robot model and exact axis configuration are not provided; simulator uses a configurable six-axis exhibition robot.
Alarm codes/messages, thresholds and engineering values are synthetic and must not be represented as FANUC defaults.
OEE and AI insight fields are explicitly AIonOS-derived in this package.

robot_config.note: Normalized synthetic contract for dashboard development. Replace adapter mappings when real FANUC samples/configuration are provided.

derived_insights.title: Dashboard data became stale during edge reconnect
derived_insights.explanation: The stale interval is a connectivity condition and must not be presented as a robot fault.
